test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill blank 4.
solution:
The correct answer is 'as much as'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's check each option-

 
 
• as long as- provided that.
 
• as much as- even though.
 
• as such as- as the word is usually understood; exactly.
 
• *as more as- used to say that two things are equal in amount or degree*
 
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate word to fill in the blank 4 is 'as much as'.
 
• Thus, 'option 2' is the correct answer.

Correct sentence: *In fact, they store__ more carbon than any other ecosystem, with peatlands alone storing twice __**as much as**__ all the world's forests*.
